title: Agora Meeting Copilot
tagline: A real-time meeting where an AI teammate can listen, respond, and take action.
description: A multi-participant Agora RTC meeting app with an AI teammate powered by OpenAI GPT-Live-1. The AI listens on a wake phrase, produces speaker-attributed live transcripts via Agora Real-Time Speech-to-Text, and manages a shared Kanban board through voice-triggered tools, all behind a Fastify orchestrator that keeps Agora and OpenAI secrets off the browser.
author: zicojiao
